title: Voynich Manuscript Research
subtitle: Evidence, transcription choices, exploratory findings, and the path to a tested reading

pages.alt: Five research stages: corpus records and exploratory constraints are recorded; a registered hypothesis, validated translation, and independent reproduction remain pending.

pages.alt: The ten-side pilot spans six catalog groups. The Yale index has 213 scan views and 204 explicitly labeled numbered sides. Scan views, folio sides, and text loci are distinct units.
pages.caption: What the evidence covers
pages.credit: Generated with image_gen from the pilot inventory and Yale image-index audit; all diagrams and manuscript-like illustrations are schematic.
pages.note: Metadata counts do not establish image coverage. Shared scans and overlapping inventories are shared evidence. Image-to-text review remains necessary.

pages.alt: ZL3b and IT2a share 5,214 present text locations. GC2a and RF full and basic are representation comparators. Spacing, source versions, alphabets, and uncertainty policies affect measurements.
pages.caption: How the text is represented
pages.credit: Generated with image_gen from the transliteration decision and comparator audits. Glyph-like marks are schematic, not a transcription.
pages.note: Transliteration records shapes and uncertainty; it supplies no decoded meaning. Paired representations are not independent experiments.

pages.alt: For 3,884 shared P0 locations, the primary ZL split/exclude treatment yields 272 equal adjacent pairs versus an expectation of 270.77. Split and joined spacing retain 33,299 and 30,908 tokens.
pages.caption: What has been measured
pages.credit: Generated with image_gen from the merged token and repetition baseline report, PR #21. Token circles illustrate the control schematically.
pages.note: An exploratory conditional-control result on encoded tokens, not established words or glyphs. It supplies no untouched test set or validated decoding.

pages.alt: PRs 28 and 33 preserve paragraph and source annotation differences; PR 32 records seven pilot links and three mapping gaps. Issue 13 remains open. Mapping review, a frozen split, registration, and reproduction are future steps.
